scope_statement: The deterministic scope is the public behavior of rhythm.py, score.sh, and representative rule families exposed by the exactly pinned slop-detector integration. The integration inventory covers each scorer metric family and stable CLI output contract; it does not claim one fixture per private upstream word, trigram, or regex entry.

inventory.target: rhythm sentence-length mean, population standard deviation, coefficient of variation, short/long counts, and classification boundaries
rhythm.contraction and formal-form counts, including Unicode apostrophes

not_applicable.boundary: The function counts matches and calculates a ratio; it has no classification threshold.

inventory.target: rhythm.anaphora run detection and minimum run length
sentence segmentation across terminals, decimals, and abbreviations

not_applicable.boundary: Segmentation has discrete protected-token cases rather than a numeric threshold.

inventory.target: Markdown prose extraction for headings, code, lists, quotes, tables, links, entities, and Unicode
rhythm CLI stdin, file, UTF-8, empty-input, and missing-file contracts
raw punctuation counts and contextual guidance/severity
score.sh selection order, exact npx pin, forwarding, status, and unavailable behavior
slop-detector 1.2.0 lexical rules: base forms, inflections, boundaries, meanings, isolation/repetition, passage length, and technical register

not_applicable.boundary: The covered contract is exact normalized trigram membership; there is no per-rule threshold.

inventory.target: slop-detector 1.2.0 formal and contracted contrast constructions

not_applicable.boundary: The covered construction regexes are discrete matches; density is reported separately by the scorer.
The covered phrase trope is an exact phrase-family match with no threshold.

not_applicable.positive: Whether a three-item construction is abusive is contextual; the deterministic contract covers only the raw threshold result.
not_applicable.negative: GOLD-LIST-001 carries the no-action contextual assessment rather than claiming the raw match should disappear.

bundled_metrics: sentence-length mean, population standard deviation, and coefficient of variation
short (<=8 words) and long (>=30 words) sentence counts
contraction and enumerated formal-form counts plus contraction ratio

verified_metric_families: normalized final score and component metric rendering
external_integration.reproducibility: package.json uses an exact version, package-lock.json locks the full dependency graph, npm ci installs it, and run.py verifies node_modules/slop-detector/package.json before invoking the repository-local binary.

exclusions: The private upstream catalogue is not copied into this repository and is not exhaustively tested entry by entry; representative public rule-family contracts are pinned to version 1.2.0.
Patterns 1-33 that require contextual or semantic judgment do not have deterministic implementations merely because they appear in the qualitative catalogue.
Golden rewrites are not executed by CI and never use exact-string equality.
URL fetching and model behavior are outside the deterministic harness.
Register, voice, author intent, and whether a raw signal warrants editing remain editorial unless a later deterministic policy explicitly implements them.

future_behavior.decision: Fact-preservation behavior may become enforceable beyond the golden rubric. #7 stated the safeguard in SKILL.md and is closed; the GOLD-VERIFY-* family records it editorially until a deterministic checker exists.
Link destinations and other Markdown extraction gaps should be excluded from prose metrics.
Punctuation advice should account for quotations and deliberate authorial use.
Verification behavior may add deterministic evidence checks while preserving qualified claims.
Severity should use passage context instead of any-match escalation.
Catalogue policy must decide how literal and legitimate domain uses affect actionable findings.
